response_log_behavior: kernels_output writes response.log to <kernel-slug>.log on the first page only
comparison_contract: Preflight and compare the complete session-output file_name set; hash and count downloaded local bytes. The API exposes no remote byte size or checksum, so do not claim remote-byte identity verification.
version_contract: The provider request is current-slug scoped, not version-pinned. Bind the unique pushed slug to root push v1 and exact downloaded spec/source hashes; do not infer an API version filter.
